caption: The drawing depicts a single female figure standing, dressed in a full-length, vibrant blue gown with long sleeves and wide, off-the-shoulder neckline. The dress has a fitted bodice with a pleated or gathered waist, and is adorned with gold or yellow lace trim around the cuffs, neckline, and hem. The woman has fair skin, rosy cheeks, and is shown with blonde hair styled in an elaborate updo with braids and decorative dark ribbons or bands. She is wearing a gold necklace, drop earrings, and possibly other small jewelry. Behind her, at head level, are two round, grey medallions or plaques hanging on the wall, each depicting a profile of a classical or cameo-style bust, one on the left facing right and one on the right facing left. The composition centers the figure, and the background is plain and unadorned, featuring no further objects or scenery. The artist's signature, "Eugene Croe," is written in blue in the lower right corner.
title: Doll: "Eugenia"
